z-index: 1; } .style-agentic .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 32px 0 0 0; padding: 0; color: #111827; max-width: 85%; z-index: 1; } .style-agentic .step { position: absolute;
